title: anthyllis sericea subsp. henoniana
intro: Anthyllis sericea subsp. henoniana, commonly known as Henon Anthyllis, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the legume family. It is used in herbal medicine, particularly in traditional European practices, due to its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Henon Anthyllis include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and act as a mild sedative. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
